what: PDMD 4-step at full rank against FlashGen, the first look at PDMD (docs/research/pdmd/2026-10-01_what_pdmd_is.md). The owner's scenes, 2026-10-01: three t2va bank scenes (radio drama, stairwell dialogue, covered market), ref2va with the old man (1-man.png) in the mountain landscape (2-mountain_landscape.png), and i2va with the old man as the first frame.
why: FlashGen is PDMD's closest sibling: same objective family, a 4-step LoRA at the call, Euler at 12/3. The pair differs only in the LoRA and its schedule (PDMD on `simple`, FlashGen on its own ManualSigmas); images, prompt, checkpoint, canvas, sampler and Sol match per scene. i2va and ref2va are untrained transfers for both distills, and ref2va also runs PDMD on the Ref2VA checkpoint. Seed-matched clips from two distills are different samples (docs/h3_distills.md, the box at the top), so the owner judges blind pairs over the scenes.

seeds.note: held: one seed per scene, the pair differs only in the distill

blind: blind_batch.py --pairs pdmd,flashgen over the rows, then the lean pairs-only page (docs/eval_comparison.md, 'The lean pairs-only session')
order: per scene, PDMD then FlashGen, so the second arm reuses the scene's text encode. The two LoRAs share no sampler cache.
next: If PDMD holds up, kijai's resize arm (h3_probe_t2v_pdmd_kijai_4step) on the same t2va scenes; the 2-step probe after that.
